kb.q: Clinic ki timing kya hai? Sunday khula hai?
kb.a: Clinic Mon–Sat subah 10:00–2:00 aur shaam 5:00–9:00 khula rehta hai. Sunday closed. 🕐
kb.tags: timing time hours open close sunday chutti kab

kb.q: Payment kaise kar sakte hain? UPI chalega?
kb.a: Cash, UPI (GPay/PhonePe/Paytm) aur card — sab chalta hai. Insurance/cashless abhi available nahi hai.
kb.tags: payment upi gpay phonepe paytm cash card insurance cashless paisa

kb.q: Root canal me kitna time lagta hai? Dard hoga?
kb.a: RCT usually 1–3 sittings me complete hota hai (20–40 min per sitting). Local anesthesia me procedure painless hota hai — exact plan doctor check-up ke baad batayenge.
kb.tags: root canal rct dard pain sitting time kitna

kb.q: Braces ka kharcha kitna aata hai?
kb.a: Braces consult ₹1,000 hai. Full treatment cost case par depend karti hai (metal/ceramic/aligners) — consult me doctor exact estimate de denge.
kb.tags: braces aligners tedhe daant wire cost kharcha

kb.q: Bacchon ka ilaj hota hai? Kitni age se?
kb.a: Ji haan, Kids Dentistry available hai (1 saal ki age se). Pehli visit friendly hoti hai — bas dar mat bataiye, doctor handle kar lenge. 😊
kb.tags: kids bacche bacha child baby age children

kb.a: C21 Mall ke paas, Vinay Nagar Complex ki 2nd floor par. Building ke neeche free 2-wheeler parking, car parking mall me. Google Maps par "Sharma Dental Clinic Vijay Nagar" search karein.
kb.tags: parking address location kahan pata map directions reach

kb.q: Pehli visit me kya lana chahiye?
kb.a: Bas aap aur purane dental reports/X-rays (agar hain). Baaki sab clinic me ho jayega. Pehli baar 10 min jaldi aayein taaki form bhar sakein.
kb.tags: first visit pehli kya lana bring reports xray x-ray documents

kb.a: Digital X-ray same visit par WhatsApp par bhej diye jaate hain. Physical copy chahiye to reception se le sakte hain.
kb.tags: report reports xray x-ray digital copy milte
